stories.title: Gilberto Mora rescata al Tri: México empata con Colombia en debut de Rafa Márquez

en.title: Gilberto Mora rescues Tri: Mexico draws with Colombia in Rafa Márquez's debut
en.summary: The 17-year-old Mexican player scored his first international goal to secure a 1-1 draw against Colombia in Baltimore during Rafa Márquez's debut as national team coach.

stories.title: Miles marchan en México para exigir respuestas al caso Ayotzinapa 12 años después

en.title: Thousands march in Mexico demanding answers in Ayotzinapa case 12 years later
en.summary: Parents of Ayotzinapa youth led a demonstration joined by student teachers and activists. The march sought responses regarding the case that occurred over a decade ago.

stories.title: Alexis Vega pone en duda su continuidad con Selección Mexicana; esta es la razón

en.title: Alexis Vega questions his continuity with Mexican National Team; this is the reason
en.summary: The Toluca striker expressed uncertainty about his future with Mexico's national team following a draw against Cruz Azul. His comments reflect concerns about his role in the squad.

stories.title: México y Colombia empatan en debut de Rafa Márquez; Gilberto Mora rescata al Tri en Baltimore

en.title: Mexico and Colombia draw in Rafa Márquez's debut; Gilberto Mora rescues Tri in Baltimore
en.summary: A young Mexican player scored an impressive goal to earn a draw for Mexico against Colombia during the coach's first match.

stories.title: Salva Mora debut de Márquez como DT de la Selección Mexicana

en.title: Mora saves Márquez's debut as Mexico national team coach
en.summary: Gilberto Mora scored to give Rafael Márquez's inaugural match as Mexico's coach a 1-1 result against Colombia.

stories.title: Alexis Vega aplica un “Messi”: analiza retirarse de la Selección Mexicana

en.title: Alexis Vega applies a "Messi": considers retiring from Mexican National Team
en.summary: Toluca's captain is contemplating his future with Mexico's national team due to dissatisfaction with playing time at the 2026 World Cup. He indicated an announcement about his decision will come soon.

stories.title: Polo tocará tierra: ¿a qué hora llegará a Baja California Sur y con qué categoría?

en.title: Hurricane Polo will touch land: what time will it arrive in Baja California Sur and what category?
en.summary: Hurricane Polo maintains Category 4 strength but is expected to weaken before reaching Baja California Sur. The system will bring torrential rainfall and waves up to 10 meters high.

stories.title: Sale Ruffo del Altiplano; lo trasladan a Ensenada

en.title: Ruffo leaves Altiplano prison; transferred to Ensenada
en.summary: Ernesto Ruffo was granted house arrest and transferred from Altiplano prison to his residence in Ensenada, Baja California.

stories.title: Marchan del Ángel al Zócalo por 12 años del caso Ayotzinapa

en.title: March from the Angel to the Zócalo for 12 years of the Ayotzinapa case
en.summary: On the 12th anniversary of the Ayotzinapa case, parents and student teachers marched from Mexico City's Angel of Independence monument to the Zócalo.

stories.title: Exgobernador Ruffo sale del Altiplano; cumplirá prisión domiciliaria en Ensenada

en.title: Former governor Ruffo leaves Altiplano; will serve house arrest in Ensenada
en.summary: Former governor Ruffo was released from Altiplano prison and will serve his sentence under house arrest in Ensenada.

stories.title: Huracán Polo baja a categoría 4; Gobierno llama a extremar medidas de prevención

en.title: Hurricane Polo drops to category 4; Government calls for heightening prevention measures
en.summary: Hurricane Polo has weakened to category 4 status, with the Mexican government urging increased precautions ahead of impacts expected in Baja California Sur on Monday and Sonora on Tuesday.

stories.title: "Polo" se debilita a categoría 3 y continúa su avance hacia Baja California Sur; sigue en vivo su desplazamiento

en.title: "Polo" weakens to category 3 and continues its advance toward Baja California Sur; its movement tracked live
en.summary: Hurricane Polo weakened to category 3 and continues moving toward Baja California Sur as its progression is monitored.

stories.title: EU y China abrirán un "canal de comunicación" sobre la inteligencia artificial

en.title: US and China will open a "communication channel" on artificial intelligence
en.summary: The US and China confirmed they will meet for the third and fourth times this year, with their next meeting scheduled for the APEC summit in Shenzhen in November.

stories.title: Bangkok, capital de Tailandia, declara estado de desastre tras casi 48 horas de lluvias torrenciales

en.title: Bangkok, capital of Thailand, declares disaster state after nearly 48 hours of torrential rains
en.summary: Bangkok has declared a disaster state following intense rainfall that caused canal overflow and forced the closure of 13 roads due to flooding.

stories.title: Tupperware encara el reto de llegar a nuevas generaciones con sus tradicionales ventas por catálogo

en.title: Tupperware faces challenge of reaching new generations with its traditional catalog sales
en.summary: Tupperware, which previously aimed to expand into physical retail spaces like supermarkets, is adjusting its strategy following its bankruptcy restructuring process.

stories.title: México envejeció en cinco años y la presión por pagar pensiones apenas comienza

en.title: Mexico aged in five years and pressure to pay pensions is just beginning
en.summary: Mexico's population has aged significantly, with one in six households already receiving pensions. Public spending on pensions is projected to reach 2.5 trillion pesos by 2027.

stories.title: Trump rechaza el plan iraní para reabrir el estrecho de Ormuz

en.title: Trump rejects Iranian plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz
en.summary: Iran proposed reopening the Strait of Hormuz within seven days following approval of an agreement, but Trump rejected the proposal.
